chartblenderaninteractivesystemforauthor.en: Creates and embeds charts in video, using object and camera tracking to keep them synchronized with the scene. Customizable templates and editing tools reduce frame-by-frame authoring work.
chartblenderaninteractivesystemforauthor.zh: 将图表嵌入视频，通过物体与相机追踪让图表随场景同步运动；结合可定制模板和编辑工具，减少逐帧调整的制作工作。

cogblendertowardscontinuouscognitiveinte.en: Rewrites prompts to represent extreme cognitive states, then blends their flow-matching velocity fields to continuously control image valence, arousal, dominance, and memorability.
cogblendertowardscontinuouscognitiveinte.zh: 将提示词改写为不同认知属性的极端状态，再混合它们对应的流匹配速度场，连续调控生成图像的效价、唤醒度、支配感与可记忆性。

densicrafterphysicallyconstrainedgenerat.en: Optimizes density fields from pretrained 3D generators to create lightweight hollow objects that can stand stably while preserving their outer shape. Physical constraints avoid simulation, and printed prototypes validate fabrication.
densicrafterphysicallyconstrainedgenerat.zh: 优化预训练 3D 生成模型的密度场，在保留外形的同时得到轻量、能稳定站立的中空物体。用无需仿真的物理约束优化结构，并通过实际打印验证可制造性。

designedtospreadagenerativeapproachtoenh.en: Combines a topology-free diffusion influence indicator with a reinforcement-learning editor to generate audience-aware text or images, improving information diffusion while preserving the original meaning.
designedtospreadagenerativeapproachtoenh.zh: 结合无需网络拓扑的传播影响力指标与强化学习编辑器，生成面向目标受众的文本或图像，在保留原意的同时提升信息传播效果。

driftawaremultimodaluserrepresentationle.en: Combines static profiles, short- and long-term behavior, and a sparse mixture of interest experts to track changing user preferences. Three-stage training improves interest and interaction prediction on social media datasets.
driftawaremultimodaluserrepresentationle.zh: 融合静态画像、短期行为与长期依赖，并用稀疏混合专家表示并存的多种兴趣，追踪用户偏好的变化；三阶段训练提升了社交媒体中的兴趣与交互预测。

freeshellacontextfree4dprintingtechnique.en: Prints flat triangular tiles joined by heat-shrinkable connectors. Heating draws the tiles into a target 3D shell, while optimized mesh flattening improves precision and reduces dependence on materials and fabrication conditions.
freeshellacontextfree4dprintingtechnique.zh: 将三角片和热收缩连接件平面打印出来，加热后由连接件牵引拼合为目标三维壳体；通过网格展平优化提高成形精度，并减少对材料与制作条件的依赖。

fromlatentinfluencetolanguagediffusionor.en: Optimizes content features for diffusion, decodes them into natural-language descriptions of audience susceptibility, and uses these descriptions to rewrite multimodal content. Evaluation shows higher predicted diffusion influence than the tested baselines.
fromlatentinfluencetolanguagediffusionor.zh: 先优化有利于传播的内容特征，再将其解码为自然语言描述的受众易感特征，用来指导多模态内容改写。实验中，生成内容的预测传播影响力优于所比较的方法。

emoticraftertexttoemotionalimagegenerati.en: Maps continuous valence–arousal values into text features so users can specify both image content and emotion. An emotion-focused loss strengthens emotional expression while retaining alignment with the prompt.
emoticraftertexttoemotionalimagegenerati.zh: 把连续的效价—唤醒度数值映射到文本特征，让用户同时指定图像内容与情绪，并通过情绪损失函数强化情绪表达，同时保持与提示词内容一致。

fundingthefrontiervisualizingthebroadimp.en: Links research grants to publications, patents, policy documents, clinical trials, and news. Coordinated visualizations and predictive models help users examine downstream funding impacts and explore future investment opportunities.
fundingthefrontiervisualizingthebroadimp.zh: 将科研资助与论文、专利、政策文件、临床试验和新闻关联起来，通过联动可视化与预测模型，帮助用户分析资助的下游影响并探索未来投资机会。

mvcrafteranintelligentsystemformusicguid.en: Generates scripts from musical semantics, creates video clips, and aligns them to music using dynamic beat matching and visual-envelope warping. An editing interface lets users refine the resulting music videos.
mvcrafteranintelligentsystemformusicguid.zh: 从音乐语义生成脚本和视频片段，再通过动态节拍匹配与视觉包络变形实现音画同步，并提供编辑界面供用户调整生成的音乐视频。

personalizingproductswithstylizedheadpor.en: PicMe converts face photos into stylized vector portraits for personalizing products. Two experiments and a user study assess portrait generation and how the resulting designs support self-expression.
personalizingproductswithstylizedheadpor.zh: PicMe 将人脸照片转为风格化矢量头像，用于个性化产品设计；通过两项实验与用户研究，评估头像生成效果及其对自我表达的支持。

bringcliparttolife.en: ClipFaceShop uses reference clipart to edit facial attributes in photos. A lightweight adaptor in StyleGAN’s latent space transfers attributes such as hair or beard across the clipart–photo gap without paired training data.
bringcliparttolife.zh: ClipFaceShop 用参考剪贴画控制人脸照片的属性编辑，通过 StyleGAN 潜空间中的轻量适配器迁移发型、胡须等特征，无需成对训练数据即可跨越剪贴画与照片的域差异。
